feeds.title: Canberra Times
feeds.description: The Canberra Times is a daily newspaper, published by Fairfax Media in Canberra. It features breaking news, local perspective on politics, national, world, business and sports news and more.

feeds.title: Her Canberra Magazine
feeds.description: Her Canberra is a website for womens of the Canberra region. The website posts about topics of interest to the Capital's female population. Follow us to keep up with articles on style, life, food and drink, city, people, active, business, magazine and weddings from Her Canberra.

feeds.title: LIFE in Canberra Magazine
feeds.description: LIFE in Canberra Magazine was published by Andrew Sikorski. It is a pictorial magazine featuring people, places and events in Canberra.

feeds.title: Canberra Critics Circle
feeds.description: Canberra Critics Circle runs across all the major art forms. Their aim is to provide a focal point for Canberra reviewers in print and electronic media through discussions and forums.

feeds.title: Capital Football News
feeds.description: Capital Football offers competitive and friendly competitions for all ages and experience levels, as well as pathways into coaching. Their events includes school activations, club activities, a women's pre-season tournaments, and coaching courses for women's football teams.

feeds.title: Kanga Cup News
feeds.description: The Kanga Cup is the governing body for football in Canberra. It is the largest International Youth Football Tournament in the Southern Hemisphere. Their mission is uniting the Youth of the World through Football.

feeds.title: Canberra Jazz blog
feeds.description: The Canberra Jazz (CJ) blog was founded by Eric Pozza. They offer news and reviews of local jazz events, and record the local jazz scene through pics of performing artists in their habitat.

feeds.title: Food Porn Journal
feeds.description: Food Porn Journal is an online blog that showcases delicious food photography and explores the culinary wonders of Canberra. The journal offers an amazing set of recipes, restaurant reviews, and engaging content for food lovers to indulge in.

feeds.title: So Frank
feeds.description: So Frank shares a unique perspective on the modern, urban and rural life in Canberra and the surroundings. Follow us to keep up with articles on local events, amazing food, coffee, wine, travels, lifestyle and many from So Frank.

feeds.title: Travel and Beyond Blog
feeds.description: Travel and Beyond was started in 2011 for the purpose of documenting their holidays. They are dedicated to documenting their travels both local and foreign with the purpose of sharing informative details on places, culture, food and also interest in history, culture and architecture.

feeds.title: Eat Canberra
feeds.description: Eat Canberra was launched by Amelia Bidgood in 2015 to showcase the amazing food and beverage scene in Canberra. She loves to be active and is passionate about increasing awareness for mental health, homelessness and many other causes. Follow us to keep up with articles on food, travel, recipes and reviews from Canberra.

feeds.title: McIntyre Property News
feeds.description: McIntyre Property offers Canberra a fresh, fun and professional approach to real estate through their extensive knowledge of the local market, and a personal, honest approach. They support local sports teams, numerous charities and tonnes of schools.

feeds.title: Who Shot The Photographer Blog
feeds.description: Who Shot The Photographer is an Australian wedding photographer based blog in Canberra, published by James Harber. He takes love-struck couples on awesome adventures and create art work for them.

feeds.title: Canberra Quilters Blog
feeds.description: Canberra Quilters Inc is the oldest patchwork group in Australia. Founded in 1976 by Margaret Rolfe. They offer a wide range of services for it's members. Their aim is to promote the art and craft of patchwork and quilting.

feeds.title: The Riotact
feeds.description: The RiotACT is a digital regional news website and opinion platform that creates and facilitates conversations about life in the Canberra region. Their aim is to expose Canberra to itself. It features news, opinion, business, property, food and wine, motoring, community and lifestyle stories.

feeds.title: OutInCanberra
feeds.description: OutInCanberra is Canberra's first and longest standing digital guide to the nation's capital. It is an independent restaurant, bar, fashion and entertainment website. Follow us to keep up with articles on dining, nightlife, entertainment, style, lifestyle, people and many from OutInCanberra.

feeds.title: Canberra CityNews
feeds.description: CityNews provides news, reviews and information related to Canberra. It also features articles on local events, politics and stories on lifestyle, arts, fashion, gardening and more.

feeds.title: A Stylish Moment
feeds.description: A Stylish Moment is a Canberra lifestyle blog published by Jemma Mrdak, writing all about style, wellness, travel and lifestyle. She hopes to share her daily inspiration and thought. She is also extremely passionate about mental health awareness, and regularly shares her personal stories and struggles.
